about: Enum variables: the layout starts at a variant; a guard compares it with `===` to a variant and `!==` to another variable of the enum; an assignment stores a variant, another variable or a conditional of two variants. A saved or observed value is the variant's declared name, `agenda_list`, not the constant a backend spells for it. Expected values are derived from the document, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: each variable starts at the variant its expr names
a month zooms to a day, remembering the month
back: the layout differs from the one it came from
back again: the two are equal, so the guard `layout !== previous` is false
a conditional of two variants: a month swaps to a week
a week swaps to a month
a variant spelled with an underscore is saved as the document wrote it
no zoom transition takes an agenda: nothing changes
